import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:isolate';

import 'package:adele_contract/adele_contract.dart';
import 'package:adele_environment/adele_environment.dart';
import 'package:adele_plugin_backend_support/adele_plugin_backend_support.dart';

// Test transport/checkpoints only. Each AOT activation owns its own state;
// implementations have no registry, shared roots, or access to another backend.
Future<void> runProbeBackend(
  List<String> arguments,
  Object? bootstrapMessage,
  Map<String, Map<String, AdeleBackendDispatcher>> Function(ProbeState)
  contexts,
) async {
  final bootstrap = bootstrapMessage! as Map;
  final responses = bootstrap['responsePort'] as SendPort;
  final options = jsonDecode(arguments.single) as Map;
  final exposures = AdeleCapabilityExposure.fromReady({
    'capabilityExposures': options['exposures'],
  });
  final hostRequests = AdeleHostRequestMultiplexer(send: responses.send);
  final state = ProbeState(hostRequests, options);
  final router = AdeleConfigurationContextRouter(contexts: contexts(state));
  final commands = ReceivePort();
  (bootstrap['bootstrapPort'] as SendPort).send({
    'kind': 'ready',
    'commandPort': commands.sendPort,
    'pluginBackendProtocolVersion': adelePluginBackendProtocolVersion,
    'capabilityExposures': exposures.map((e) => e.toMap()).toList(),
  });
  try {
    await for (final Object? message in commands) {
      if (hostRequests.handleResponse(message)) continue;
      if (message is! Map) continue;
      if (message['kind'] == 'request' && message['method'] == 'shutdown') {
        state.releaseAll();
        hostRequests.close();
        await router.close();
        responses.send({
          'kind': 'response',
          'requestId': message['requestId'],
          'ok': true,
          'payload': {'stopping': true},
        });
        break;
      }
      if (message['kind'] == 'request' && message['serviceId'] == 'probe') {
        if (message['method'] == 'terminate') Isolate.exit();
        unawaited(state.control(message, responses.send));
        continue;
      }
      if (message['kind'] == 'request') {
        state.requests.add({
          'configurationContext': message['configurationContext'],
          'serviceId': message['serviceId'],
          'method': message['method'],
          'hostInvocationContext': message['hostInvocationContext'],
          'payload': message['payload'],
        });
      }
      unawaited(router.handle(message, responses.send));
    }
  } finally {
    state.releaseAll();
    hostRequests.close();
    commands.close();
    await router.close();
  }
}

final class ProbeState {
  ProbeState(this.hostRequests, this.options);
  final AdeleHostRequestMultiplexer hostRequests;
  final Map<Object?, Object?> options;
  final requests = <Map<String, Object?>>[];
  final reads = <Map<String, Object?>>[];
  final processes = <Map<String, Object?>>[];
  final failures = <String>[];
  final clients = <String, AuthorizedEnvironmentReadServiceClient>{};
  final bufferedClients =
      <String, AuthorizedEnvironmentBufferedProcessServiceClient>{};
  Future<bool>? _queuedBuffered;
  final _arrived = <String, Completer<void>>{};
  final _gates = <String, Completer<void>>{};

  Future<void> checkpoint(String key) async {
    final arrived = _arrived.putIfAbsent(key, Completer<void>.new);
    if (!arrived.isCompleted) arrived.complete();
    await _gates[key]?.future;
  }

  void releaseAll() {
    for (final gate in _gates.values) {
      if (!gate.isCompleted) gate.complete();
    }
  }

  Future<void> control(
    Map command,
    void Function(Map<String, Object?>) send,
  ) async {
    try {
      final payload = command['payload'] as Map;
      final key = payload['key'] as String?;
      Object? result;
      switch (command['method']) {
        case 'hold':
          _gates.putIfAbsent(key!, Completer<void>.new);
        case 'wait':
          await _arrived
              .putIfAbsent(key!, Completer<void>.new)
              .future
              .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 10));
        case 'release':
          final gate = _gates[key]!;
          if (!gate.isCompleted) gate.complete();
        case 'snapshot':
          result = {
            'requests': requests,
            'reads': reads,
            'processes': processes,
            'failures': failures,
          };
        case 'queueBuffered':
          // The reverse frame is sent before this command's acknowledgement.
          // This proves queue admission without a sleep or provider-side entry.
          _queuedBuffered = hostRequests
              .bind(
                hostInvocationContext: payload['token'] as String,
                serviceId: authorizedEnvironmentBufferedProcessServiceId,
              )
              .request(
                payload['identity'] == true
                    ? authorizedEnvironmentBufferedProcessServiceCapturedIdentityId
                    : authorizedEnvironmentBufferedProcessServiceRunBufferedProcessId,
                payload['identity'] == true
                    ? {}
                    : {
                        'request': {
                          'program': 'git',
                          'arguments': [
                            '-c',
                            'adele.probeAction=queued',
                            'hash-object',
                            '--stdin',
                          ],
                          'relativeWorkingDirectory': '',
                          'timeoutSeconds': 5,
                          'stdinBase64': '',
                        },
                      },
              )
              .then((_) => true, onError: (Object _) => false);
          result = {'queued': true};
        case 'queuedResult':
          result = {'ok': await _queuedBuffered!};
        case 'retainedBufferedIdentity':
          try {
            final identity = await bufferedClients[key]!.capturedIdentity();
            result = {
              'ok': true,
              'sessionId': identity.sessionId,
              'environmentId': identity.environmentId,
            };
          } on Object {
            result = {'ok': false};
          }
        case 'retainedBuffered':
          try {
            await bufferedClients[key]!.runBufferedProcess(
              EnvironmentBufferedProcessRequest(
                program: 'git',
                arguments: const [
                  '-c',
                  'adele.probeAction=retained',
                  'hash-object',
                  '--stdin',
                ],
                relativeWorkingDirectory: '',
                timeoutSeconds: 5,
                stdinBase64: '',
              ),
            );
            result = {'ok': true};
          } on Object {
            result = {'ok': false};
          }
        case 'retained':
          try {
            await clients[key]!.readFile('retained');
            result = {'ok': true};
          } on Object {
            result = {'ok': false};
          }
        case 'attack':
        case 'attackBuffered':
          try {
            final buffered = command['method'] == 'attackBuffered';
            await hostRequests
                .bind(
                  hostInvocationContext: payload['token'] as String,
                  serviceId:
                      payload['service'] as String? ??
                      (buffered
                          ? authorizedEnvironmentBufferedProcessServiceId
                          : authorizedEnvironmentReadServiceId),
                )
                .request(
                  payload['method'] as String? ??
                      (buffered
                          ? authorizedEnvironmentBufferedProcessServiceRunBufferedProcessId
                          : authorizedEnvironmentReadServiceReadFileId),
                  Map<String, Object?>.from(
                    payload['arguments'] as Map? ??
                        (buffered
                            ? {
                                'request': {
                                  'program': 'git',
                                  'arguments': [
                                    '-c',
                                    'adele.probeAction=attack',
                                    'hash-object',
                                    '--stdin',
                                  ],
                                  'relativeWorkingDirectory': '',
                                  'timeoutSeconds': 5,
                                  'stdinBase64': '',
                                },
                              }
                            : {'relativePath': 'attack'}),
                  ),
                );
            result = {'ok': true};
          } on Object {
            result = {'ok': false};
          }
        default:
          throw StateError('Unknown probe command.');
      }
      send({
        'kind': 'response',
        'requestId': command['requestId'],
        'ok': true,
        'payload': jsonDecode(jsonEncode(result)),
      });
    } on Object catch (error) {
      send({
        'kind': 'response',
        'requestId': command['requestId'],
        'ok': false,
        'error': {'code': 'probe_failure', 'message': error.toString()},
      });
    }
  }
}
